title: Application to remove park land for Monitor Point, Greenpoint
summary: This application would amend the City Map to eliminate a portion of Inlet Park between Quay Street and the U.S. Bulkhead Line in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, allowing related property acquisition or disposition. It is one of several linked land use actions that would together enable a mixed-use development with about 1,150 housing units, including 300 income-restricted units, plus commercial, community facility and open space. The City Planning Commission approved the change on May 13, 2026, and the Council held a public hearing on May 27, 2026.
